'''Xuss''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who fought in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He tasked with clearing the Separatist volcano stronghold. He later hired help to assist in destroying Separatist anti-aircraft weapons before landing his troops.
